en: Black‑and‑white image showing a busy wooden pier where a crowd of people in early‑20th‑century clothing watch or board a steamship named "STYRSÖ". The vessel is moored alongside the pier with smoke coming from its funnel, and another similar boat is visible in the background. Low rocky shores with scattered wooden houses line the opposite side of the waterway, and flags fly from poles near the pier. The overall look is that of a historical coastal ferry scene.
